hooks.description: Blocks a Claude-initiated git commit/push or gh pr create/merge when the staged schema change has a confirmed NON-NEGOTIABLE violation (via the shared validator, scripts/validate_schema.py). Bypass requires a validated reason, not a boolean — export TALEEMABAD_DATA_STANDARDS_BYPASS="<real reason>"; see reference/enforcement-policy.md and hooks/schema-change-gate.sh.

Blocks an Edit/Write the instant it would introduce a confirmed NON-NEGOTIABLE violation into a schema/migration file — live, while the file is being written, not just at commit time. Same shared validator and same bypass mechanism as schema-change-gate.sh (TALEEMABAD_DATA_STANDARDS_BYPASS); schema-change-gate.sh stays in place as the commit-time backstop for anything this misses (a human editing outside Claude Code, etc.). See hooks/live-schema-edit-gate.py for exactly what can and cannot trip this.
